strategyReview: One-touch NO edge (live 4/4, avg +18.4%) and WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG (live 74% WR, +$1.29) continue to be the strongest performers. PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW on BTC and OIL is also solid (70-80% WR). FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG overall is underwater (avg -0.54%, 45% WR) with stops eating small winners. Gold one-touch heatmap shadows (0% WR) and AMZN perp convergence variants (42% scorable WR, many unscorable burns) are clear failure clusters, while BTC PM IV expansion reversion (30% WR) and weekend funding reversion on individual equities (CBRS 50%, AAPL 33%) are below breakeven.

failureClusters.evidence: H-534 (0% WR on 12 scorable tests) predicts >2% gold decline from underlying-cap edge ≥10 pts, but gold has steadily risen. The edge comes from PM IV compression rather than genuine overpricing.
failureClusters.recommendation: Add near-expiry filter (d≤30) and require actual sell-yes edge (sell_yes_edge_pts ≥1) to narrow to contracts where the edge is more likely to decay, and consider a regime filter that avoids strong bullish gold trends.

failureClusters.evidence: H-058 (basis > -0.05, funding >0) predicts stock/perp convergence, but recent tests all show funding stuck at 5.5% with no normalization; 27% WR over 13 scorable tests, plus 82 unscorable burns.
failureClusters.recommendation: Add a confirmation that funding is already declining (e.g., amzn_hl_funding_ann_change_pct_24h < -5) to avoid entering before any mean reversion begins.

failureClusters.theme: BTC PM IV gap volatility fade
failureClusters.evidence: H-001 (PM IV <46, options IV >49, ratio <0.92) has dropped to 30% WR. The IV gap persisted during quiet markets and did not deliver >2% moves.
failureClusters.recommendation: Switch to percentile-based compression: btc_pm_iv_percentile_30d <10 and btc_opt_iv_90d_percentile_30d >90, targeting extreme relative compression rather than absolute thresholds.

failureClusters.evidence: CBRS (H-539, 50% WR) and AAPL (H-537, 33% WR) both target rapid funding normalization on weekends, but funding often deteriorates further or stays flat, killing the thesis.
failureClusters.recommendation: Require funding to already be rising (change_pct_24h >0) alongside the negative threshold, and restrict to weekends to confirm the weekend-specific reversion hypothesis.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of AMZN perp convergence: only enter when AMZN basis is near zero ( > -0.05 ), funding is positive AND funding has just started to decline (change_pct_24h < -5), signaling that the period of persistent flat funding is ending.
newHypotheses.prediction: AMZN stock continues outperforming perp as funding reverts and basis stays near zero.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of gold one-touch heatmap: only short when the underlying-cap edge is ≥10 pts AND there is an explicit sell-yes edge (sell_yes_edge_pts ≥1) on contracts expiring within 30 days, ensuring the edge is tradeable and near enough to be resolved.
newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD spot declines >2% within 2 days as the near-expiry sell edge decays.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of BTC PM IV expansion reversion: replace absolute IV thresholds with extreme compression percentiles – PM IV in bottom 10% of 30-day range and 90-day options IV in top 10% of its range, signaling a rare cross-market IV crush that should resolve with a large move.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot moves >2% within 3 days as the extreme IV compression normalises.

newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS spot moves >2% within 2 days as funding continues to normalize.

newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL spot moves >2% within 2 days as funding reversion continues.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of BTC listed-IV momentum confirmation: tighten momentum thresholds. Require spot gain >1.5% in 24h, spot above 0.5% vs 24h SMA, within 3% of 7d high, and 30d IV change >1% (double the original 0.75% and 0% thresholds) to filter for stronger, IV-confirmed breakouts.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot continues to gain >2% within 3-7 days on confirmed momentum and IV expansion.

newHypotheses.prediction: BTC one-touch NO contract price (YES) will decline over the next 7 days as dumb-money enthusiasm fades.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AMZN perp convergence hypothesis with basis > -0.05 and funding >0 repeatedly saw funding stuck at 5.5% for days without decline. The assumption that positive funding naturally reverts to lower levels quickly failed in current regime, leaving the thesis unwound.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AMZN funding rate above zero naturally declines to sub-10% within days, allowing perp convergence.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Gold one-touch heatmap short (cap edge ≥10) produced 0% WR over 12 scorable tests as gold rose. The edge was driven by PM IV compression rather than genuine directional overpricing, so no downside spot move materialised.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on gold upside touch contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: BTC PM IV expansion reversion dropped to 30% WR; in recent quiet markets the IV gap persisted without triggering a >2% move. The absolute IV thresholds failed to distinguish truly explosive compression events.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: PM IV underpricing options IV by >8% reliably leads to a >2% absolute spot move within 3 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: CBRS weekend funding reversion (funding < -10) only managed 50% WR; losses occurred when funding either stayed negative or moved more negative instead of normalizing. The blind entry captured many continuation moves.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Extreme negative weekend CBRS funding rapidly normalizes, causing a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL weekend funding reversion (funding < -10) delivered only 33% WR; funding often remained low or drifted lower, erasing the expected bounce. The hypothesis over-relied on mean reversion without confirmation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Extreme negative weekend AAPL funding rapidly normalizes, leading to a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: BTC listed-IV momentum confirmation (long) has a 50% scorable WR but the recent sample shows many small losses and only one strong win. The momentum and IV thresholds were too lenient, picking up weak impulses that did not sustain beyond 2%.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC spot gaining vs short-term trend with positive IV change yields >2% further gain within 3-7 days.

journalEntry: Tonight’s review reinforces that the system’s strongest edges are in time-bound, edge-based one-touch NO sales and the weekend funding reversion on liquid perps. FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG struggles with a 2.5% stop that cuts many green trades; we may need to widen to 3-3.5% once data supports it. AMZN convergence and gold heatmap families need mechanical rethinking, not more threshold searches. The smart-flow asymmetry FIND is promising and deserves its first shadow tests. No parameter changes are made tonight – we will wait for more resolution on the open GOLD short and the weekend reversion shadows before tuning risk parameters.
